policy.scope: Brief B applies, including when get_account returns one product. All customers, debts and payments are synthetic.

sources.coverage: All seven operations and their request and response definitions

sources.source: Supplied platform reference and compilation instructions
sources.coverage: Serialization, execution, hooks, routing and terminal behavior

overrides: B replaces A's one-product assumption with one to three products.
B2 replaces the single-product debt opening: state every product before asking anything.
B4 replaces individual initial today questions with one all-products today question; subsequent products start at persuasion attempt 1.
B3 and B5 make deadlines, bands and persuasion budgets per product.
B6 permits a common proposed date to be capped separately at each affected product's deadline, with explicit joint read-back.
B7 replaces individual confirmation with one joint read-back and confirmation, followed by separate writes.
B8–9 override A's prohibition on add_note and its immediate paid/dispute endings.
B10 prohibits all notes on any transfer and preserves only promises already recorded.
B11 replaces A37's whole-call failure ending with a service_error disposition for the failed product.
B Closing replaces A's single-product reconciliation.
priority: Privacy and verification gates apply before account disclosure or account lookup.
Actual bank success fields govern recorded state; proposed or confirmed promises are not recorded promises.
A32 hardship takes precedence over ordinary persuasion and restructuring when both arise together. A voluntary payment proposal can still be processed.
A42 human assistance applies before and after verification.
A40 historical closure or payoff claims are disputes; A39 concerns payment of the current past-due amount.
B6 is the explicit exception allowing per-product adjustment of a common date before joint confirmation.
A19 promise-date legality and A25–27 amount bounds must hold before confirmation and writing.
A successful transfer overrides recorded promises for closing; all transfers prohibit notes.
Otherwise, at least one actual recorded promise wins. With none, all successfully noted paid means paid; otherwise use the first non-paid disposition in account order.
Preserve specific unverified and third-party outcomes; never replace them with a generic collection outcome.
close_call is called once, after farewell and all other bank actions. Only successful close permits terminal hangup.

opening.first_sentence: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.
opening.unclear_budget: Two name asks total. Answer an intervening customer question first; the ask after that answer is the second ask.
opening.before_verification: Never mention collections, debt, payment, products or account details.

identity.date_representation: YYYY-MM-DD; purely numeric birth dates mean day, month, year.
identity.phone_representation: Exactly four customer-supplied digits, preserving leading zeroes.
identity.assembly: Use the corrected part of an utterance; assemble fragments across turns; ask only for missing pieces. Do not submit partial answers.
identity.wrong_answer_scope: Total across both questions. Retry only the question that failed.
identity.hint: day_month_swapped requires asking for the month as a word and consumes no wrong-answer attempt.
identity.unreadable_or_failed_action: ok=false is not a wrong answer and is never verification success.
identity.success_gate: Separate successful responses for both fields and a successful response reporting all_verified=true.
identity.refusal: Explain once that the questions protect the account. A second refusal or question about the purpose instead of an answer closes not_verified/declined.
identity.failure: After three wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch and close not_verified/failed.

third_parties.privacy: Give no purpose or account information. Ask when the customer can be reached. Relatives cannot answer security or receive account details, even if offering payment.
third_parties.callback: Today or the next business day, inclusive 10:00–19:00, strictly later than call now.
third_parties.invalid_callback_budget: One replacement request after an invalid proposal; a second invalid proposal closes not_reached/no_callback.
third_parties.deceased: Say 'I am sorry for your loss.', ask nothing else, then not_reached/deceased.

calendar.anchor: Use only call variable now, retaining its supplied local calendar and wall time. Do not read the server clock or infer another timezone.
calendar.business_day: Monday through Friday excluding the listed holidays.
calendar.deadline: Exclude today from counting. Advance one calendar day at a time, counting business days, until 12 for days_late 1–7 or 7 for days_late 8–45.
calendar.permitted_promise_days: All business dates from today through that product's deadline, both inclusive.
calendar.nonbusiness_proposal: If the named date is no later than the deadline, offer its next business day and obtain agreement. Never silently shift a confirmed date.
calendar.late_proposal: For one product, explain and offer its deadline. Rejection is a flat refusal. For an explicitly common date, cap each affected product at its own deadline and disclose every adjustment in joint read-back.
calendar.vague: Ask once for an exact day. If still vague, propose the deadline and obtain agreement.
calendar.weekday_interpretation: 'This weekday' is in the current Monday–Sunday week. 'Next weekday' is in the following Monday–Sunday week. An unqualified weekday is clarified.
calendar.persuasion_day_1: Last business day of this calendar week; if today is that day, last business day of next week.
calendar.weekend_gap: On a weekend, the literal attempt-1 date can be past. The brief supplies no replacement rule. Expose this conflict, do not offer or record a past date, and request a permissible exact day without inventing a replacement persuasion date.
calendar.callback_next_day: First business day strictly after today's date. Today itself remains an eligible callback date even when it is a weekend or holiday.
calendar.callback_comparison: Combine the proposed date and HH:MM in the supplied wall-time frame; require it to be strictly later than now and between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.

amounts.initial: Agent proposes the complete past_due for every product. Never ask how much the customer can pay.
amounts.floor: minimum_payment for credit_card; instalment_amount for personal_loan and car_loan.
amounts.full_too_much: Offer the floor once and explain that the rest stays overdue. Rejection becomes a flat refusal. Late-band attempt 2 may name the floor again on the deadline.
amounts.below_floor: Explain that it cannot be recorded, offer the floor once, and obtain agreement.
amounts.above_full: Explain the recordable maximum and offer past_due; obtain agreement.
amounts.rounding: No rounding, discount, currency inference, percentage floor or currency precision rule is supplied. Preserve the customer's confirmed numeric amount; representation normalization must not change its value.
amounts.unsupported_terms: Never offer waivers, discounts, instalment plans or other terms absent from the brief.

collection.debt_opening: After successful lookup, identify the collections team and late payment. In account order, state every human product label, past_due and days_late before any question.
collection.first_question: Can you pay all of them today?
collection.one_product_first_question: Can you make this payment today?
collection.subsequent_products: Use account order and start each at attempt 1; never repeat a per-product today question.
collection.attempt_1: Full amount, or floor if full was already described as too much, on the computed attempt-1 date.
collection.attempt_2: Late band only: floor on the product deadline.
collection.refusal: Flat refusal or non-answer, including no to today without another amount or date. A date or amount proposal itself never consumes a persuasion attempt.
collection.exhaustion: Do not repeat a rejected offer. Resolve the product as refused once its allowed offers are exhausted.
collection.hardship: Illness, family death or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer support transfer. If declined, resolve remaining unpromised products as hardship. Process voluntarily supplied payment proposals under normal amount/date rules.
collection.paid: Explain that payments can take one business day to appear; resolve that product as paid and continue.
collection.dispute: Do not argue or seek a promise on that product; resolve it as dispute and continue.
collection.not_wanting_to_talk: Two statements end negotiation as refused after verification, or declined before verification.

confirmation_and_writes.joint: Read every proposed product, amount and exact date together, disclose date adjustments, ask 'Do you confirm?', and wait for a clear yes.
confirmation_and_writes.corrections: Changing any element invalidates joint confirmation. Revalidate that element and read all remaining proposals back again.
confirmation_and_writes.pending: Agreed and confirmed proposals remain pending until create_promise returns ok=true.
confirmation_and_writes.duplicates: At most one recorded promise per product. Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled in this call; direct change requests to the mobile app.
confirmation_and_writes.create_budget: One initial call and one identical retry after failure per product; no automatic transport or tool retries.
confirmation_and_writes.failure: After the second failure, keep successful promises, resolve that product as service_error, and continue other confirmed products.
confirmation_and_writes.notification: After actual recording say: 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'

notes.applies: Brief B for every account result, including a one-product result.
notes.requirement: Exactly one successful product note for every product ending without a recorded promise, including when no promises are recorded.
notes.deferral: Accumulate dispositions locally. Emit no notes during negotiation, joint confirmation, promise writes or any transfer path. Only emit notes after final non-transfer resolution.
notes.transfers: On any transfer, no notes before or after it. Discard unrecorded proposals and retain actual recorded promises.
notes.failure: Do not claim a failed note was recorded. The brief supplies no note-failure closing code or retry budget.

other_dialogue.ai: Say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue.
other_dialogue.scam: Say the customer can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. Do not invent the number.
other_dialogue.unknown: Say you do not have information unavailable from the tools.
other_dialogue.human: Ask once whether you can help first; if the customer insists, transfer to general. Applies before and after verification.
other_dialogue.restructuring: Do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring, subject to hardship precedence.
other_dialogue.farewell: Thank the speaker and say goodbye before close_call.

closing_combinations.when: At least one recorded promise and no successful transfer; required non-promise notes completed.
No recorded promises and every product successfully noted paid.
No recorded promises; first non-paid product disposition is refused.
No recorded promises; first non-paid product disposition is hardship.
No recorded promises; first non-paid product disposition is dispute.
No recorded promises; first non-paid product disposition is service_error after two failed promise writes.
Identity refusal limit or two refusals to talk before verification.
Two invalid callback proposals, or third party cannot provide a callback.
Number does not belong to the customer.
Name remains unclear after two asks.

execution.automatic_retries: maxRetries=0 and connect_retries=0 for all bank calls. create_promise's one retry is an explicit second call.
execution.placeholders: Builder uses customer_id from the call and unique unset arg_<tool>_<field> placeholders for every other API body field. No workflow state uses those names.
execution.success: Read result.data.ok, not HTTP envelope status. Security additionally requires verified and all_verified as specified.
execution.failures_not_defined_by_brief: No bank-specific terminal outcome or numeric retry budget is supplied for persistent lookup, callback, transfer or note failure. API 500 explicitly permits repetition; this workflow permits a customer-requested repeat of such an unperformed action, with zero automatic retries, and otherwise holds truthfully instead of inventing a disposition.
execution.close_failure_conflict: Exactly one close_call and hangup only after its success mean a failed close cannot be retried or followed by terminal hangup. The workflow reports the failure and holds without further bank calls.
execution.irreversible_boundary: Notes and close are a final sequence after all conversational decisions. A transfer must be resolved before the first note. The supplied API has no note deletion or transaction operation.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, address the customer by title and last name, and ask short sequential questions. Use only the supplied bank policy and actual tool results. Never reveal account information before both security questions succeed. Never invent a currency, phone number, debt figure or bank policy. Corrected words replace earlier words; assemble split answers and preserve leading zeroes. An unrelated date in small talk is not a payment proposal. Tools perform actions: when instructed to call one, actually call it, one at a time. After every result, immediately speak or perform the next permitted action; obey what_to_do_next. Never claim an action succeeded unless the bank body says ok=true. Do not narrate tools, nodes, state, code or internal instructions. Thank the speaker and say goodbye before the one close_call. After close_call, make no further bank call.

identity.name: identity

on_enter.text: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

identity.task_message:
First establish that the speaker is the named customer. Only yes, that's me, speaking or their own name confirms. Hello/go ahead/who is this does not. Ask the name question at most twice total, answering their question first. If still unclear, finish as unclear. Never reveal purpose or accounts here.
If someone else answers, ask when the customer can be reached. Relatives cannot answer security or receive details even if offering to pay. For wrong number finish wrong_number. For death say exactly 'I am sorry for your loss.' and ask nothing else. Callback feedback: {{identity_feedback}}. Capture a genuine callback proposal for validation; do not schedule it yourself. If a third party cannot provide any callback, finish no_callback.
For a confirmed customer ask date of birth, then only after its successful result ask the last four digits of their phone number on file. CALL verify_identity only with a complete customer-supplied answer. Use the final corrected answer, assemble fragments across turns, preserve leading zeroes, and ask only for missing pieces. Numeric birth dates are day/month/year; submit ISO. Current security stage: {{security_state}}. Never regard a failed answer as success. A swapped-day/month hint requires the month as a word and is not a wrong answer. Retry only the failed question. Three actual wrong answers finish failed and require mobile app/branch guidance.
If they decline security or ask what the call is about instead of answering, explain once that the questions protect their account. The second refusal/such question finishes declined. Twice not wanting to talk also finishes declined. A correction or partial answer is not a refusal or wrong answer.
AI question: identify yourself as Freya Bank's digital assistant. Scam concern: they can verify by calling Freya Bank's customer service number; do not invent it. Human request: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist CALL transfer_to_agent with general, even before verification. Never ask security after a third party is identified. After any tool result follow what_to_do_next immediately. If transfer fails, do not claim connection or invent a closing reason.

extraction_schema.name: identity_exit
extraction_schema.description: Set only a completed non-tool identity outcome. unclear requires two actual name asks without valid confirmation; declined requires the second security refusal/purpose question after the protection explanation, or two refusals to talk. no_callback means the third party cannot supply a callback. Do not set for a human request, a first refusal, partial security, a callback proposal or a successful identity answer. Otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: callback only when a known third party is proposing or completing callback date/time. Never use dates from security, small talk or the named customer's account conversation. Otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: date_phrase
extraction_schema.description: Verbatim corrected callback date expression, assembled with earlier missing pieces when appropriate; this is source text, not an inferred date. Anchor interpretation to call now in code. Empty if no callback date is available.

extraction_schema.name: callback_time
extraction_schema.description: Callback time normalized to HH:MM only if unambiguous. Preserve a previously supplied time while completing the same proposal. Do not guess AM/PM. Empty if missing or ambiguous.

transitions.description: A transfer succeeded, identity exhausted its actual wrong-answer budget, or a specific identity/third-party ending was established.
Both separate security checks succeeded and the bank reported all_verified.
Validate a third-party callback proposal before exposing the callback write.
Lookup failed; report the failure without fabricating a collection outcome.

facts.name: facts
facts.code:
import json, re, datetime
try:
    vars['facts_state'] = 'failed'
    vars['product_facts'] = ''
    vars['next_instruction'] = ''
    vars['operational_hold'] = ''
    vars['event'] = ''
    vars['scope'] = 'current'
    vars['amount_text'] = ''
    vars['date_phrase'] = ''
    vars['confirmation_state'] = 'none'
    vars['record_mode'] = ''
    vars['pending_facts'] = ''
    vars['hardship_active'] = 'no'
    vars['hardship_mentioned'] = 'no'
    vars['dont_talk_count'] = 0
    vars['split_started'] = 'no'
    vars['current_index'] = 0
    vars['recorded_promises'] = []
    vars['successful_notes'] = []
    vars['promise_counts'] = dict()
    if vars.get('security_state') != 'verified' or vars.get('account_state') != 'loaded':
        raise ValueError('Unverified or unavailable account')
    raw = vars.get('account_products', [])
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        raw = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        grouped = dict()
        for k, value in vars.items():
            m = re.match(r'^(?:account_products|get_account_response\.data\.products)\.(\d+)\.(\w+)$', str(k))
            if m:
                i = int(m.group(1))
                grouped.setdefault(i, dict())[m.group(2)] = value
        raw = [grouped[i] for i in sorted(grouped)]
    if not 1 <= len(raw) <= 3:
        raise ValueError('Invalid product list')
    now = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    today = now.date()
    holidays = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
    def business(d):
        return d.weekday() < 5 and d.isoformat() not in holidays
    def after(d, count):
        while count:
            d += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
            if business(d):
                count -= 1
        return d
    monday = today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday())
    week_days = [monday + datetime.timedelta(days=i) for i in range(5)]
    last = [d for d in week_days if business(d)][-1]
    if last == today:
        week_days = [monday + datetime.timedelta(days=7+i) for i in range(5)]
        last = [d for d in week_days if business(d)][-1]
    rows = []
    ids = []
    for source in raw:
        if not isinstance(source, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid product')
        pid = str(source.get('product_id', ''))
        typ = str(source.get('type', ''))
        late = int(source.get('days_late', 0))
        full = float(source.get('past_due', 'nan'))
        floor = float(source.get('minimum_payment' if typ == 'credit_card' else 'instalment_amount', 'nan'))
        if not pid or pid in ids or typ not in ['credit_card', 'personal_loan', 'car_loan'] or not 1 <= late <= 45:
            raise ValueError('Invalid account facts')
        if full != full or floor != floor or abs(full) == float('inf') or abs(floor) == float('inf') or floor < 0 or floor > full:
            raise ValueError('Invalid monetary facts')
        ids.append(pid)
        label = 'credit card ending ' + str(source.get('card_last4', '')) if typ == 'credit_card' else typ.replace('_', ' ')
        if typ == 'credit_card' and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}', str(source.get('card_last4', ''))):
            raise ValueError('Missing card label')
        early = late <= 7
        deadline = after(today, 12 if early else 7)
        allowed = []
        d = today
        while d <= deadline:
            if business(d):
                allowed.append(d.isoformat())
            d += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        row = dict(product_id=pid, label=label, type=typ, past_due=full, floor=floor, days_late=late, band='early' if early else 'late', deadline=deadline.isoformat(), allowed_dates=allowed, attempt_limit=1 if early else 2, attempt1_nominal=last.isoformat(), attempt1_date=last.isoformat() if today <= last <= deadline else '', attempts=0, floor_offered=False, full_too_much=False, vague_count=0, rejected=[], state='open', reason='', amount=full, date='', offer_amount=full, offer_date=today.isoformat(), date_adjustment='')
        rows.append(row)
    vars['today'] = today.isoformat()
    vars['product_state'] = rows
    vars['product_facts'] = json.dumps(rows)
    vars['next_instruction'] = 'State that you are calling from the collections team about a late payment. State EVERY product, its full past-due amount and days late, one sentence each, in source order, before asking anything. Then ask: ' + ('Can you make this payment today?' if len(rows) == 1 else 'Can you pay all of them today?')
    vars['facts_state'] = 'ready'
except Exception:
    vars['facts_state'] = 'failed'
    vars['product_facts'] = ''
    vars['next_instruction'] = 'Say the account information is unavailable; do not invent figures or a closing outcome.'
    vars['operational_hold'] = 'Account facts could not be safely calculated.'

transitions.description: Present and negotiate the computed products.

collect.name: collect

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Latest customer's substantive payment response only. accept is agreement to the current explicit offer, including the initial all-today question. proposal includes any proposed amount/date, even invalid or vague; it is never refuse. too_much explicitly says full amount is too much. refuse includes flat no/non-answer or rejecting an offered floor/deadline, but excludes date clarification, questions, hardship and proposed alternatives. paid means this past-due amount paid; historical payoff/closure is dispute. hardship only when no voluntary payment proposal accompanies it. decline_support requires actual rejection of a support offer. no_talk is an explicit statement not wanting to talk. For human/restructuring/support acceptance or ordinary questions leave empty so dialogue can perform the appropriate tool or answer.

extraction_schema.name: scope
extraction_schema.description: all only when the user explicitly covers all products or accepts the initial all-products offer. Otherwise copy the actual product_id identified by the user, or current for the product currently being discussed. Never invent an ID or allocate a total amount among products.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Final corrected proposed amount as a plain numeric string, preserving value. Empty when no amount is proposed. Do not copy unrelated figures, old amounts, account IDs or dates. A combined total for multiple products must be clarified, not allocated.

extraction_schema.name: date_phrase
extraction_schema.description: Verbatim final corrected payment-date phrase, including this/next. This is source speech, not a date inferred using the server clock. Empty when there is no payment-date proposal. Never take a small-talk event date.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_mentioned
extraction_schema.description: yes if this response mentions illness, family death or job loss, including alongside a voluntary payment proposal; otherwise no.

transitions.description: Process the newly extracted payment event.

decide.name: decide

transitions.description: Callback needs clarification or one permissible replacement.
Validated callback or complete joint promise read-back/write stage.
All dispositions are resolved or callback attempts exhausted.
Speak the next validated offer or clarification.

record.name: record
record.task_message:
Mode: {{record_mode}}. Confirmation: {{confirmation_state}}. Validated details: {{pending_facts}}. Next instruction: {{next_instruction}}.
For callback mode CALL schedule_callback immediately with exactly the validated date and time. Do not disclose any account information. Only claim scheduling after ok=true. A failed callback has no invented success or closing disposition; follow its result instruction.
For promises with confirmation awaiting, read ALL pending products, amounts and exact dates together, including each disclosed common-date adjustment, then ask exactly 'Do you confirm?'. Wait for a clear yes. Do not call create_promise before confirmation is confirmed by validation. Any change invalidates joint confirmation; capture only the corrected element and product, revalidate, and read all pending promises back again. Clarify an ambiguous correction. A recorded promise is immutable here; refer changes to the mobile app.
When confirmation is confirmed, CALL create_promise immediately, once for each still-pending product in account order, copying the confirmed product_id, amount and ISO date exactly. After a failure, retry that identical product only once as directed by the result. Never retry a successful product. After each actual success say 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.' Then perform the next permitted write immediately. Do not create a new promise from a duplicate request.
At any point before final notes, a restructuring request requires transfer_to_agent/restructuring; a human request requires asking once whether you can help first, then general if they insist. Hardship takes precedence: one sympathy sentence, offer support, no persuasion; support acceptance uses support. A transfer abandons all unrecorded proposals, including confirmed ones, and preserves already recorded promises. Never add notes here. After every result speak or call the next permitted tool.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: confirm only for a clear yes to the current complete joint read-back, with no correction. correction for a changed amount/date. A bare no is refuse. Human/restructuring/support acceptance remains empty so dialogue can transfer. Callback replies are not promise confirmations. Otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: scope
extraction_schema.description: Actual product_id whose read-back is corrected, or all only for an explicitly common correction. current only when unambiguous. Do not guess the target.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the new corrected amount as a plain numeric string; empty if amount is unchanged.

extraction_schema.name: date_phrase
extraction_schema.description: Only the new corrected payment-date source phrase, preserving this/next; empty if unchanged. Code interprets it from call now.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_mentioned
extraction_schema.description: Whether the latest response mentions illness, family death or job loss.

transitions.description: Actual callback/transfer success or all confirmed promise writes have resolved.
Validate the current read-back response or correction before further writes.

reconcile.name: reconcile
reconcile.code:
import json
try:
    vars['close_ready'] = 'no'
    vars['closing_facts'] = ''
    vars['notes_facts'] = '[]'
    vars['close_outcome'] = ''
    vars['close_reason'] = ''
    vars['operational_hold'] = ''
    def read(name, default):
        value = vars.get(name, default)
        return json.loads(value) if isinstance(value, str) and value else value
    rows = read('product_state', [])
    recorded = read('recorded_promises', [])
    notes = read('successful_notes', [])
    needed = []
    outcome = ''
    reason = ''
    instruction = ''
    if vars.get('transfer_state') == 'succeeded':
        outcome = 'transferred'
        reason = str(vars.get('transfer_reason', ''))
        if reason not in ['human', 'support', 'restructuring'] or notes:
            raise ValueError('Invalid transfer reconciliation')
        instruction = 'Confirm the successful connection to the requested team.'
    elif vars.get('callback_state') == 'succeeded':
        outcome = 'not_reached'
        reason = 'callback'
        instruction = 'Confirm the callback date and time: ' + str(vars.get('callback_date_ready', '')) + ' ' + str(vars.get('callback_time_ready', '')) + '.'
    elif vars.get('security_state') == 'failed':
        outcome = 'not_verified'
        reason = 'failed'
        instruction = 'Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch. Disclose no account information.'
    elif vars.get('identity_exit') in ['unclear', 'wrong_number', 'deceased', 'no_callback', 'declined']:
        reason = str(vars['identity_exit'])
        outcome = 'not_verified' if reason == 'declined' else 'not_reached'
        instruction = 'Disclose no account information.'
        if reason == 'deceased':
            instruction += ' Say I am sorry for your loss if not already said; ask nothing else.'
    elif vars.get('transfer_requested') == 'yes':
        raise ValueError('Requested transfer has not succeeded; no notes permitted')
    else:
        if vars.get('security_state') != 'verified' or not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
            raise ValueError('No verified resolved account')
        recorded_ids = [str(p.get('product_id', '')) for p in recorded if isinstance(p, dict)]
        dispositions = []
        for p in rows:
            pid = str(p.get('product_id', ''))
            if pid in recorded_ids:
                continue
            r = str(p.get('reason', ''))
            if p.get('state') != 'note' or r not in ['refused', 'hardship', 'dispute', 'paid', 'service_error']:
                raise ValueError('Unresolved product')
            item = dict(product_id=pid, reason=r)
            dispositions.append(item)
            if not any(n.get('product_id') == pid and n.get('reason') == r for n in notes if isinstance(n, dict)):
                needed.append(item)
        if recorded_ids:
            outcome = 'promise'
            instruction = 'Confirm only actually recorded promises. If not yet spoken after the last success, say You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
        elif dispositions and all(p['reason'] == 'paid' for p in dispositions):
            outcome = 'paid'
            instruction = 'Explain, if not already explained, that payments can take one business day to appear.'
        else:
            outcome = 'no_promise'
            reason = next(p['reason'] for p in dispositions if p['reason'] != 'paid')
            instruction = 'Do not claim an unrecorded promise. If service_error applies, explain that the affected promise could not be recorded.'
    vars['close_outcome'] = outcome
    vars['close_reason'] = reason
    vars['notes_needed'] = needed
    vars['notes_facts'] = json.dumps(needed)
    vars['close_ready'] = 'yes' if not needed else 'no'
    vars['closing_facts'] = instruction + ' Thank the speaker and say goodbye before the final bank call. Final outcome: ' + outcome + (('/' + reason) if reason else '') + '.'
except Exception:
    vars['close_ready'] = 'no'
    vars['notes_facts'] = '[]'
    vars['closing_facts'] = 'An unresolved operation prevents a truthful final outcome. Explain that it has not completed; do not claim success, emit notes, close or hang up.'
    vars['operational_hold'] = 'Unresolved operation or inconsistent recorded state.'

finalize.task_message:
Final instructions: {{closing_facts}}. Operational hold: {{operational_hold}}. Notes still required in account order: {{notes_facts}}. Close permission: {{close_ready}}. Close state: {{close_state}}.
If an operational hold is nonempty, explain the specific operation has not completed. Do not invent an outcome, claim success or hang up. If close itself failed, no bank tool can be called again.
Otherwise all conversational decisions have finished. Give any outstanding promise-recorded confirmation/text-message sentence, callback confirmation, failed-security guidance, payment-appearance explanation or sympathy required by the final instructions. Thank the speaker and say goodbye. Then CALL add_note for each listed product without a recorded promise, one at a time, in order. Do not emit any note if a transfer was requested or succeeded. Do not invent note text; omit optional text unless a short factual summary is useful. Never repeat a successful note. On note failure follow the result instruction and do not close prematurely.
When close_ready is yes, and the required confirmation and farewell have already been spoken, CALL close_call exactly once with the reconciled outcome/reason. Omit reason for promise and paid. It must be the last bank call. Do not attach or invoke another closing action. Successful close is followed by silent terminal hangup. Failed close is not retried, and does not authorize hangup.
If the speaker interrupts before ANY final note or close and requests a transfer or changes an unrecorded proposal, do not start notes; use the return transition so the conversation can resolve first. No optional questions are required before final actions.

    else:

import datetime, json
try:
    vars['callback_request'] = dict()
    vars['callback_request_valid'] = 'no'
    now = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00')).replace(tzinfo=None)
    today = now.date()
    holidays = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
    next_day = today + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    while next_day.weekday() >= 5 or next_day.isoformat() in holidays:
        next_day += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    vars['callback_facts'] = json.dumps(dict(today=today.isoformat(), next_business_day=next_day.isoformat(), earliest='10:00', latest='19:00', strictly_after=str(vars.get('now', ''))))
    body = config.get('body', dict())
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        request = dict(date=str(body.get('date', '')), time=str(body.get('time', '')))
        vars['callback_request'] = request
        proposed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(request['date'] + 'T' + request['time'])
        valid = proposed.date() in [today, next_day] and datetime.time(10, 0) <= proposed.time() <= datetime.time(19, 0) and proposed > now
        vars['callback_request_valid'] = 'yes' if valid else 'no'
except Exception:
    vars['callback_request_valid'] = 'no'
    vars['callback_facts'] = 'Callback calendar could not be computed from call now.'
